# Membrane Ogg plugin v0.5.2 - Table of Contents

> Ogg Plugin for Membrane Multimedia Framework

## Pages

- [Membrane Ogg Plugin](https://membrane-ogg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-ogg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Ogg.Demuxer](https://membrane-ogg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Ogg.Demuxer.md): A Membrane Element for demuxing an Ogg.
- [Membrane.Ogg.Muxer](https://membrane-ogg-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Ogg.Muxer.md): A Membrane element for muxing streams into a OGG container.
For now only supports muxing a single Opus track containing one stream (mono or stereo).
